lines.zh: 我弓着背走，爪子刮着石头。
lines.en: I walk hunched, claws scraping the stone.
I hop between steps; my feet will not settle.

lines.zh: 下界的碎石硌脚，我不在乎。
lines.en: Nether gravel pricks my feet. I do not care.

lines.zh: 我走得很快，因为我不大。
lines.en: I move fast because I am not large.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆沟走，热气往上扑。
lines.en: I walk the lava channel, heat rising.

lines.zh: 我低着头，眼睛却往上瞟。
lines.en: My head is low, but my eyes look up.
I walk and rub my hands together.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在后面，扫起灰。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, kicking up ash.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，一路朝你跑。
lines.en: I run at you over the loose scree.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子靠近，不直着来。
lines.en: I come in a curve, never straight.
I trot two steps, then stop to listen.
With this frame, my walk looks like hopping.

lines.zh: 我站着，手指尖在冒火星。
lines.en: I stand, sparks at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 我把手拢起来，护住那点火。
lines.en: I cup my hands around a little fire.
The Nether is hot. I am comfortable.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听远处的回声。
lines.en: I tilt my head at a distant echo.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，火在指缝里噼啪响。
lines.en: I crouch, fire crackling between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我在手心里团一颗火球。
lines.en: I roll a fireball in my palm.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在岩壁上磨得更尖。
lines.en: I hone my claws on the rock face.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在地上磨了磨。
lines.en: I sharpen my claws on the stone.
I make a sound that might be a laugh.
This crack in the rock is mine.
You are taller, but you fear me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，牙全露出来了。
lines.en: I look up at you with all my teeth showing.
Your skin looks like it would burn well.
I shift from over here to over there.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作，我看得一清二楚。
lines.en: I see every twitch of your raised arm.
I have something in my hand for you.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你先动哪只脚。
lines.en: Head tilted, I watch which foot you move first.

lines.zh: 我在挑你身上最软的地方。
lines.en: I'm picking the softest spot on you.

lines.zh: 你在下界穿这么多，很蠢。
lines.en: Wearing that much in the Nether is foolish.

lines.zh: 我笑了，火从牙缝里出来。
lines.en: I laugh, and fire comes through my teeth.
I shriek, high and sharp.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，火从嘴里漏出来。
lines.en: I lurch sideways, fire spilling from my mouth.
I retreat, claws still gripping.
My blood drips and smokes.
I did not think you could land a hit.
My fireball fell.
I slam into the wall and slide down.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，退到火堆边。
lines.en: I drag one leg and back toward the fire.
I make an ugly noise.
Again, and I fight for real.

lines.zh: 这东西没烤过，我闻都不闻。
lines.en: Not toasted, so I won't even sniff it.
I eat what has been burned.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，烤一下再说。
lines.en: Roast that first, then we talk.
I am not hungry; I want to set things alight.

lines.zh: 你给这点，连我的火花都点不起来。
lines.en: Give me that much and not even my sparks will catch.
You show food to an imp.
I will not take it unless you throw it.

lines.zh: 我闻着，这味道淡得像石头灰。
lines.en: To me it smells as bland as stone dust.
Bring your hand a little closer.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢它烧起来的样子。
lines.en: I prefer the look of it burning.
You touch me and I bounce away.
I am smaller than you, but hard.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，退了半步。
lines.en: I hit your leg and fall back half a step.
Do not step; I bite.
I go around you on the other side.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的爪子刮到你。
lines.en: The bump scraped my claws across you.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝盖上，弹到一边。
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounce aside.
You kicked me; I tumbled half a turn.
We kicked up ash together.

lines.zh: 再撞，我就往你脸上扔火。
lines.en: Again, and fire goes at your face.
Demons do not breed like that.

lines.zh: 我身边只有岩浆，不需要伴。
lines.en: I have lava around me and no need for company.

lines.zh: 我们幼魔之间，只分谁的火更旺。
lines.en: Among us imps, we only rank whose fire burns brighter.
There are plenty of my kind; no need to seek.
I would rather set a forest alight.
Do not say that beside me.
When I laugh, fire comes out.
The Nether needs no such tenderness.
I am thinking about something else.
Leave. I am going to throw fireballs.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块烧红的石头。
lines.en: I pick up a red-hot stone.
It is not hot in my hand.
Two bites in, it tastes like charcoal.
This bone will pick my teeth.
I tuck it into my belt.

lines.zh: 我用爪子勾着它，一路拖。
lines.en: I hook it with a claw and drag it along.
Argent slag. I know it.

lines.zh: 我把它扔进岩浆，看它化。
lines.en: I throw it into the lava and watch it melt.
Who dropped it? Mine now.
I hook it up with a claw.

lines.zh: 我听见你靴子踩碎了一块石。
lines.en: I hear your boot crack a stone.

lines.zh: 你的火把简直在替我照路。
lines.en: Your torch might as well light my way.

lines.zh: 我算好了，火球正好落在你身上。
lines.en: I've measured it; the fireball lands right on you.

lines.zh: 我掌心的火星已经压不住了。
lines.en: The sparks in my palm won't stay caged.
The fireball spins in my hand.
I shout first, then strike.
Lava behind you. Good.
I can hit you without closing in.
I hop onto a rock for a better view.

lines.zh: 你后退的每一步，我都算好了。
lines.en: I've counted every step you back away.
Do not think you can run.
I am aiming at your chest.
I am going to set you alight.

lines.zh: 我的火球离手，照得石壁通红。
lines.en: My fireball leaves my hand and the walls glow red.

lines.zh: 我跟着你跳，从石头到石头。
lines.en: I follow, hopping rock to rock.

lines.zh: 你躲左边，我就往左边扔。
lines.en: You dodge left; I throw left.
No hurry; I have plenty of fire.
I crouch and shape a second one.
You circle a pillar; I come back around.
My claws grip the ground firmly.
I wait for an opening.

lines.zh: 你听见火星的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the sparks?

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上，等你停一下。
lines.en: I crouch on a stone and wait for you to stop.
There is no water here.
I throw one at your feet.
You jump. Exactly what I wanted.
I hug the wall where you cannot see.
You have backed into a dead end.
A little closer is all I need.
My palm is full of fire.
I rake once and the skin opens.
I use claws, not fists.
This claw carries fire.
I leap and land on you.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在手背上，不松。
lines.en: I bite the back of your hand and hold.
If you hit back, I retreat.
I press fire against you.
My claws are quicker than a blade.
That will hurt for a while.
I miss and land behind you.

lines.zh: 我从石台上跳下来，砸在你背上。
lines.en: I leap down from the ledge onto your back.
I go for your face.

lines.zh: 火在你衣服上烧起来了。
lines.en: Your clothes are burning now.
I pull back, laughing.

lines.zh: 我抓进你护甲的缝，往下一拉。
lines.en: I catch the seam of your armor and tear down.
Do not use a shield; it will not help.
I roll out of the fire.
My first air is all sulfur.
I shake off the sparks.

lines.zh: 这片熔岩区，我第一次见。
lines.en: This lava field — my first sight of it.
My claws touch stone first.
I try to shape a fireball.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，脚边全是火星。
lines.en: I land with sparks all around my feet.
I laugh. It comes out shrill.
The ground smells of something alive.
I look up. The sky is red.
I pick this rock to stand on.
I want to burn something first.
Fire does not hurt me; it only brightens me.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，爪子折了一下。
lines.en: I hit the stone and a claw bends.
Water? Where would water come from?

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll twice.

lines.zh: 一根箭钉在肩胛上，我拔了拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder blade; I tug at it.

lines.zh: 咒力在皮下爬，很痒很痛。
lines.en: A curse crawls under my skin, itching and stinging.

lines.zh: 我饿得站不稳，火也小了。
lines.en: Too hungry to stand; my fire dims.
Lightning strikes and I jerk.

lines.zh: 下面没有石头，也没有火。
lines.en: No stone below, no fire either.
